Name: ahri1014's Livestock Bats
Author: ahri1014
Description:
[font=Cambria][center][size=4]Tired of farming bat wings? Well, I have the mod for you! It’s frickin’ bats![/size]

[size=6]Livestock Bats[/size][/center][center]
All bats can be purchased from Marnie after building a bat cave![/center]
[size=3][b][color=lightblue] ﻿Basic Bat[/color][/b] - drops bat wings
[b][color=hotpink] ﻿Fruit Bat[/color][/b] - drops one foraged or tree fruit
[b][color=hotpink] ﻿Tuber Bat[/color][/b] - drops foraged tubers (snow yam, winter root, cave carrot)
[b][color=hotpink] ﻿Mushroom Bat[/color][/b] - drops red or purple mushrooms (or magma mushrooms, if you’re lucky!)
[b][color=purple] ﻿Meteor Bat[/color][/b] - drops iridium and occasionally diamonds[/size]
[size=6][center]Bat Caves[/center][/size]
[size=3]﻿Includes three seasonal caves for bats (and bats only!). Comes in [color=lightblue]normal[/color], [color=hotpink]large[/color], and [color=purple]deluxe[/color] versions. Caves can be turned off in config, which will allow bats to be placed in coops.[/size]
[size=6][center]Translations/Compatibility[/center][/size][b]
[size=3]﻿Translations:[/size][/b][size=3] i18n files are included! If you are interested in making a translation, please feel free to do so. Please reach out in DMs or in the comments so I can get your translation added to the mod page.

[/size][*][size=3][b][u]Korean Translation[/u][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33755]here[/url]! by JA3B2﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][u][b]Chinese Translation[/b][/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33768]here[/url]﻿! by bat7777[/size]
[*][size=3][u]Spanish Translation[/u] included! by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ZukaZK]ZukaZK[/url]﻿[/size]

[size=3][b] ﻿Recolors:[/b] [s]Currently only vanilla colors are included[/s], but I plan to add some recolors in the future. Recolor modifications are okay as long as you have permission from the author of the recolor and both mods (Livestock Bats and the recolor) are marked as dependencies. [color=olive]Earthy[/color] recolor now included!

[b] ﻿Compatibility:[/b] Should not have any kind of conflicts with other mods. Please let me know if you find any and I will do my best to fix it. ﻿[/size]
[size=4][center] Now Includes!: [/center][/size]
[size=3][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] [/b] patch that adds a few new features
[*]Bat Wing quality can now be adjusted in config to only drop normal quality.
[*]Iridium ores and bars have been adjusted to only drop as normal quality (though I might add a config for those as well)
[*]All animals now have a chance to drop extra produce once you reach a certain friendship level
[/size][size=6][center]Troubleshooting[/center][/size]
[size=3]When filing a bug report, please make sure to include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. You can also include a patch summary by typing or copy/pasting “patch summary ahri1014.LivestockBats” without the quotations into your SMAPI console.[/size]
[/font]
